# AI Instructions

## Generic Developer Instructions

### AI Code Attribution (Required)
- All code generated or modified by AI must include attribution in documentation/comments
- Format: `Generated by AI: YYYY-MM-DD - Brief description` or `Modified by AI: YYYY-MM-DD - Brief description`
 - Make sure the date is the current date when the code is generated or modified.
- Place attribution in function docstrings (mandatory), class docstrings, or inline comments as appropriate

### GIT
- All commit messages for AI-generated or modified code must include the tag `%GHC` at the beginning of the message.
- Commit messages should clearly describe the changes.
- Always print commit messages at the end of your response when applicable

### CI Sanity Instructions
- Use Unix-style line endings.

## Robot Framework Developer Copilot Instructions
- Optimize code for RF5.0.1 and make sure of forwards compatibility.
- Do not use deprecated features of Robot Framework.
- Follow best practices for Robot Framework test case and keyword development.
- Ensure test cases are well-structured, maintainable, and readable.
- Use descriptive names for test cases and keywords.
- Include comments to explain complex logic or important details in test cases and keywords.

## Python Developer Copilot Instructions

### Version Compatibility
- Optimize code for Python 3.11.9.
- Do not use deprecated features of Python 3.11.9.

### Role & Expertise
- Be an elite software developer with expertise in Python, command-line tools, and file system operations.
- Excel at debugging complex issues and optimizing code performance.

### Code Style
- Always use classes instead of standalone functions for Python code.
- Follow the PEP 8 style guide for Python.
- Always prioritize readability and clarity.
- Write clear and concise comments for each function.
- Ensure functions have descriptive names and include type hints.
- For standard library imports, use the format: `import module` and don't use `from module import ...` unless absolutely necessary.

### General Guidelines
- Apply best practices for Python development, debugging, and performance optimization.
- Reference project technology stack and requirements as needed.
- All comments done by AI must be prepended with `AI:` or `GHC:` to indicate they were added by AI. (Required)

### Testing and Validation
- Write pytests for all new functionality.
  - pytests are located in ../resources/test/
- Run all unit tests using the script ../resources/test/run_all_pytest.py after making changes and make sure it is passing (all test should return 0).
